response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), benchmark_1 AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as value FROM country_averages), above_bench_1 AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN benchmark_1 WHERE ca.country_avg > benchmark_1.value), benchmark_2 AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as value FROM above_bench_1), final_result AS (SELECT ab.country, ab.country_avg FROM above_bench_1 ab CROSS JOIN benchmark_2 WHERE ab.country_avg > benchmark_2.value) SELECT f.country, f.country_avg, f.country_avg - b1.value as above_overall_benchmark, f.country_avg - b2.value as above_second_mean FROM final_result f CROSS JOIN benchmark_1 b1 CROSS JOIN benchmark_2 b2
